articles.title: Blue Jays erupt for 5 runs in the eighth to beat Red Sox 6-4, extend Boston’s skid to 5
articles.description:
Willson Contreras hit his 24th home run but the Red Sox matched their longest losing streak of the season.

The post Blue Jays erupt for 5 runs in the eighth to beat Red Sox 6-4, extend Boston’s skid to 5 appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Red Sox lost to Blue Jays 6-4, marking their fifth consecutive defeat.
Willson Contreras hit his 24th home run during the game.
Boston matches its longest losing streak of the season, raising concerns among fans.
